gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-michroma: Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart, every curve drawn without a flicker of thickness change. Michroma is the plain sans that stays open and wide, while Bushcraft closes its shapes and makes the loudest statement.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads like a sans-serif drawn with thin wire, its s bends generously open and its lowercase tall. Bushcraft handles the heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Bushcraft stretches its letters apart and barely lets its capitals rise above the lowercase. Mochiy Pop P One follows in a sans with big, loose spacing and no brush-like swelling, so the heading stays the showier of the two.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-montserrat-under: Wide, tubular and a bit theatrical, Bushcraft makes its mark with closed, tightly drawn shapes. Montserrat Underline takes the other job, offering open counters and round bowls in a sans-serif that handles the steady reading while the heading handles the show.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline has big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal that keep it friendly. Mozilla Headline is the open one here, and Bushcraft, with its bent-tubing letters, earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mozilla-text: Tubular and wide, Bushcraft has bowls as heavy as its stems and capitals that barely rise. Mozilla Text brings tall, bold-looking lowercase with flared terminals, and Bushcraft earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nata-sans: Bushcraft sets wide-spaced, closed letters with no weight shifts at all. Nata Sans then settles into a sans-serif with a large central band and open curves, so a long stretch of text feels steady and technical-pen tidy.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nobile: Nobile reads as a plain sans with open letter mouths, and its capitals sit barely above the lowercase. Bushcraft supplies the bent-tubing swagger, while Nobile does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nokora: Bushcraft's t has a crossbar and stem sharing one width. Nokora brings a wide-open s and a dark, thick stripe of lowercase, so a long passage reads dense and friendly in sans-serif form.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads open and welcoming, with a generous gap in the c and capitals only slightly above lowercase. Yet Bushcraft, with no stress anywhere in its curves, adds the pair's most striking quality: a wide, tubular heading above a friendly sans.
